_doc: Transparent multi-criteria (MCDA) configuration. AnalogScore = 100 * sum_i(w_i * sim_i) / sum_i(w_i over features available for that site-reference pair). Weights per mission profile sum to 1. Fidelity (surface/process analog) and operational suitability are separate scores and are never combined. A score is a relative ranking aid for one mission objective against one reference environment; it is NOT a measure of lunar or Martian equivalence (gravity, vacuum/atmosphere, radiation, day length and temperature regime cannot be reproduced by any Earth site).

tag_equivalences._doc: Tags treated as the same class when computing Jaccard similarity (planetary class <- Earth classes).

process.note: covers volcanic / impact / aqueous / periglacial process similarity

slope.note: sim = 0.5*exp(-0.5*(dmed/4)^2) + 0.5*exp(-0.5*(dp90/6)^2); slopes compared at matched DEM baselines (Moon refs 80-118 m DEM vs Earth 90 m grid; Mars 463 m vs Earth 450 m grid)

ruggedness.note: sim = exp(-|ln(TRI_earth/TRI_ref)|), i.e. 0.5 at a factor-2 difference

thermal.note: Earth: CHELSA bio1 (fallback ERA5 mean) for surface sites; for lava-tube references the Earth value is the same air-temperature normal used as a proxy for cave interior temperature (documented approximation). Ref: literature/modeled mean surface temperature.

aridity.note: References have no liquid precipitation (AI = 0 by definition). sim = 1 if AI<=0.05 (UNEP hyper-arid), else exp(-(AI-0.05)/0.15).

ice.note: sim = 1 - |I_earth - I_ref|; I_ref = 1 if the reference has literature ice evidence (ground_ice / water_ice_cold_traps tag), else 0; I_earth = max(permafrost probability (Obu 2019, or ERA5-MAAT logistic model where Obu unavailable), WorldCover snow/ice fraction).

abiotic_surface.note: WorldCover bare/sparse + snow/ice fraction within 5 km (references are 100% unvegetated).

dust_sediment.note: SoilGrids 0-5 cm silt+clay vs reference fine fraction; only the Moon has a sourced value (≈50% by mass <60-80 um, wiki:Lunar regolith) -> approximated as 0.45 <50 um (derived, documented); Mars references are null so the feature drops out for Mars.

operational._doc: Operational test suitability (separate score). Not a fidelity measure.

access.note: sim = exp(-d/25 km); d = OSM distance to nearest highway/track; censored >150 km -> 0.0025

trafficability.note: fraction of 30 m slopes < 15 deg within 2 km

climate_workability.note: fraction of months whose ERA5 1991-2020 mean 2 m temperature is within [-25, 35] deg C

MOON_ISRU_ICE.description: Cold-trap / volatile prospecting and ice-handling tests

MOON_ROVER_MOBILITY.description: Rover/LTV trafficability on polar slopes and mare regolith

MOON_EVA_HABITAT.description: EVA and surface-habitat operations in polar highland terrain

MOON_FIELD_GEOLOGY.description: Astronaut field-geology training for impact-dominated highland crust (replaces astrobiology, which is not applicable to the Moon)

MOON_LAVA_TUBE.description: Pit / lava-tube access and subsurface habitat scouting

MARS_ISRU_ICE.description: Ground-ice prospecting, drilling and extraction tests

MARS_ROVER_MOBILITY.description: Rover traverse over crater-floor sedimentary terrain

MARS_EVA_HABITAT.description: Habitat siting and EVA on low-slope plains

MARS_ASTROBIO_SEDIMENTS.description: Biosignature search in lacustrine / deltaic / evaporitic sediments

MARS_LAVA_TUBE.description: Lava-tube / skylight access on basaltic shields

aggregation.note: Profile score = best-matching reference in the profile; the matched reference is reported. Per-reference scores are in data/processed/pair_scores.csv.

lunar_regolith_fine_fraction.quote: By mass 50% is particles smaller than 60-80μm, 10% smaller than 10μm, and 10% larger than 1mm.
lunar_regolith_fine_fraction.method: Assume fraction <50 um is somewhat below the 50% passing 60-80 um -> 0.45 (uncertainty ~ +/-0.1).

permafrost_model.note: Used only where Obu et al. (2019) is unavailable (Southern Hemisphere / <25N). MAAT = CHELSA bio1 (fallback ERA5). Threshold near -2 C reflects the common observation that permafrost becomes likely below MAAT ~ -1 to -2 C; this is a coarse proxy, not a permafrost map.
